prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 连续高行 · 发布计划 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "阶段" · longest unbreakable word 32px · one-line width 67px
  col 2: header "时间" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 44px
  col 3: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "内容" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 736px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示发布计划各阶段的日期、负责人和工作内容，供读者了解推进顺序与责任分工。","reading":"读者沿行查看每个阶段的安排，也会纵向比较日期、负责人和灰度比例；较长的内容说明决定多数行的高度。","groups":["阶段与时间共同描述发布进度，适合相邻扫描。","负责人与内容共同说明谁负责什么；内容列需要承担大部分换行。"],"keep_intact":["日期如 05-06","负责人姓名","阶段名称及灰度百分比如“灰度 50%”"],"may_wrap":["内容列中的工作说明可按中文语义自然换行；较长说明形成的行高也可容纳同一行其他单元格的换行。","空间紧张时，“负责人”表头可换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [88, 65, 67, 139] · table 360×627px · row heights [36, 36, 176, 153, 153, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [70, 65, 57, 167] · table 360×580px · row heights [60, 36, 153, 129, 129, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [88, 65, 76, 130] · table 360×627px · row heights [36, 36, 176, 153, 153, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"阶段名称、日期、姓名和全部表头均保持完整；阶段与时间、负责人与内容的相邻关系清楚，每一行也容易对应阅读。","problems":"三条长说明被挤成窄而高的文字块，连续高行使读者需要较多纵向移动才能比较计划内容。","cause":"内容列宽139px，扣除边距和边框后仅有118px可排文字；阶段、时间和负责人列分别为88px、65px和67px，保住完整标签的同时占用了大部分宽度。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"内容列更宽，长说明减少到最多六行，连续高行更紧凑；日期和姓名仍保持完整。","problems":"灰度阶段的名称与百分比被拆成两行，削弱了阶段标签作为整体的识别；“负责人”表头也换行，使表头高度增加。","cause":"阶段列70px仅留49px排文字，容不下最长的完整阶段标签；负责人列57px仅留36px，容不下三字表头。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"阶段名称、日期、姓名和表头均完整，列之间的对应关系清楚。","problems":"内容列比r0A更窄，长说明的文字块更局促，而负责人列多出的空白没有改善阅读；整体高度也没有降低。","cause":"负责人列增至76px，超过完整显示表头所需的宽度；内容列因此缩至130px，仅留109px排文字。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r1A","widths":[88,65,53,153],"change":"保留可完整显示阶段名称和日期的宽度，将负责人列收至53px，仍容纳姓名，但允许表头换行；把省出的14px分给内容列，争取改善长说明的换行，同时保持灰度阶段与百分比完整。"}]}
